fossil.definition: The hard part of an animal that turned to stone after a very long time. Fossils tell us what the animal looked like.
fossil.example: She found a yellow fossil under a huge leaf.

lts_unpartnered.definition: Describing a person who has no romantic partner, without saying whether that is a choice.
lts_unpartnered.example: He said he was unpartnered, and he said it without any apology in his voice.

mon_currency.definition: The money of a country: its notes, its coins, and the rules that govern them.
mon_currency.example: The shop takes only the local currency.

slow_travel.definition: Staying in one place for weeks or months instead of moving on every few days, which is what makes long-term work possible.
slow_travel.example: Slow travel costs less and lets you actually know the place.
